summary: Worthington Steel, Inc. (WS) filed an 8-K disclosing completion of its voluntary public cash takeover of Kloeckner & Co SE (Kloeckner). WS's subsidiary BidCo accepted 52,389,508 Kloeckner shares tendered at €11.00/share, totaling ~€576M in consideration. Including pre-existing holdings, WS now owns 60,710,791 shares or 60.86% of Kloeckner. Funding came from notes offering, term loan, and cash. A Domination and Profit and Loss Transfer Agreement (DPLTA) is pending; during the transition, Kloeckner operates independently under German law. The offer achieved majority control but fell short of 100%; watch for subsequent squeeze-out or DPLTA steps.
